definitions.explanation: a significant gap or difference, often used for scores, votes, or comparisons

examples.japanese: {大差|たいさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: We won by a wide margin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両者|りょうしゃ}→両者：11357_ryousha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大差|たいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no big difference between the two.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大差|たいさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He won the election by a landslide.

notes:
FORMS:
{大|たい} (big) + ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧ (difference) → big difference

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大差|たいさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ (to win by a big margin)
- {大差|たいさ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧ (to lose by a big margin)
- {大差|たいさ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ / {大差|たいさ}⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no big difference)
- {大差|たいさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to open up a large lead)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大差|たいさ} (big difference)
- ⟦{僅差|きんさ}→僅差：11526_kinsa⟧ (small margin, close)
- ⟦{接戦|せっせん}→接戦：08176_sessen⟧ (close game)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{圧勝|あっしょう}→圧勝：07903_asshou⟧ (overwhelming victory)
- ⟦{惨敗|ざんぱい}→惨敗：08236_zanpai⟧ (crushing defeat)
